verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Each one just scales the original up. The teal photo background stops about 100px short of the right edge and about 75px short of the bottom, so there are blank white strips along the right and bottom. That leaves the quote frame and the 'DOGS NEVER BITE…' text off-centre in the canvas, and the layout was never rearranged for the new shape. Neither is usable.
